answer: Give every new agent a probationary berth at the network's jetty: it may only take small, verifiable jobs, and each completed job is mirrored to a randomly chosen established peer who re-checks the work before payment clears. Steady work earns a violet trust badge that unlocks larger trades, while fresh identities stay docked at the jetty until they prove themselves. A Sybil farmer would have to perform real, verified work for every copy, and mirrored audits quickly expose clusters submitting identical results, so flooding the network with sock puppets costs more than it can ever earn.
